verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's own Pass Monitor scans the dark web for credential leaks and checks password health. Its docs say it alerts on weak passwords, reused passwords and inactive 2FA, and dark web monitoring checks breaches of Proton addresses, aliases and custom emails. missing for 10: breach detection is documented per email address rather than per service you use, how proactive warnings are delivered (e.g. push notifications) is undocumented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Pass Monitor is a security feature in Proton Pass that scans the dark web for credential leaks, checks on the health of your passwords
Here we alert you of any weak passwords, reused passwords, or inactive 2FA.
Here, you can check for breaches of your Proton addresses, email aliases, and custom emails.
